title: Slow recovery for Indiana’s nonprofits from COVID-19 employment losses
summary_en: A new report finds Indiana nonprofits recovered slowly from COVID-19, with uneven employment gains and ongoing challenges across key community service sectors.

title: Sweet Solution: O’Neill School research reveals powerful link between chocolate and carbon sequestration
summary_en: New O’Neill School research finds well-managed cacao agroforestry can boost soil carbon storage, supporting climate resilience, biodiversity, and sustainable agriculture.
